props.name: label
props.comment: The tab header label (a string or a node).

props.name: name
props.comment: The tab name — also its FormGroup name (its inputs register into it).

props.name: path
props.comment:
The URL path segment for this tab (URL-synced mode). Defaults to the tab
`name` for every tab after the first, and `''` (the index) for the first.
